name: ai-university
description: AI-authored open textbooks with static interactive illustrations.

scripts.build: node scripts/build-english-content.mjs && npm run validate:content && npm run typecheck && node scripts/build-book.mjs && node scripts/build-english-book.mjs && npm run build:c && node scripts/build-programming.mjs && vite build
scripts.check: npm run check:python && npm run check:ai-development && npm run build && npm run check:c && npm test
scripts.check:python: node packages/content/python/tools/validate.mjs && python3 packages/content/python/tools/verify.py && python3 packages/content/python/tools/test_traces.py && python3 packages/content/python/tools/traces.py --check && node packages/content/python/tools/build.mjs --check
scripts.check:ai-development: node packages/content/ai-development/tools/validate.mjs && node --test packages/content/ai-development/tools/git-lab.test.mjs && npm test --prefix packages/content/ai-development/project && node packages/content/ai-development/tools/build.mjs --check
